sources.entry: Magic.dev - (USA) A startup building an AI "coworker" for software engineers, designed to handle complex coding and engineering tasks.

summary.name: Magic
summary.one_liner: Magic is an AI company building frontier code models to automate software engineering and AI research, with the stated goal of reaching safe AGI.
use_cases: following AI company hiring and research news
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Magic as a company building frontier code models to automate software engineering and research. Its stated approach combines frontier-scale pretraining, domain-specific reinforcement learning, ultra-long context, and inference-time compute. The page says the company has thousands of GB200 GPUs and has raised $768 million from investors including Nat Friedman, Daniel Gross, CapitalG, Elad Gil, Sequoia, Jane Street, and Eric Schmidt. It describes itself as a small group of engineers and researchers working on a short list of fundamental research problems. The page does not describe a specific product, release, or how to use it.
notable: Claims ultra-long context and inference-time compute as core approach
Reports thousands of GB200 GPUs and $768 million in funding
Positions code automation as a path to safe AGI and alignment
caveats: Page gives no concrete product, pricing, or availability details
Listing describes it as an AI coworker for software engineers, which the page itself does not state
